facts.fact: StackAdapt's Finance group had 10 people when Kim Stedman started at the company in April 2021.
facts.quote: I started when the entire finance group was 10 people and we had 1 reportable financial entity.

facts.fact: About a year after joining in April 2021, Kim Stedman worked alongside 5 other financial directors and a finance group of 34 staff overseeing 5 reportable financial entities, per StackAdapt's blog.
facts.quote: I now work alongside 5 other financial directors, with a finance group of 34 staff, overseeing the accounting of 5 reportable financial entities!

facts.fact: StackAdapt opened subsidiaries in Singapore and Australia in late 2021, according to the company's blog.
facts.quote: in late 2021, we successfully opened subsidiaries in Singapore and Australia!

facts.fact: StackAdapt's finance team stated it hopes to be operating in new countries within Europe and Asia before the end of 2022.
facts.quote: we hope to be operating in new countries within Europe and Asia before the end of 2022.

facts.fact: Kim Stedman earned her public accounting license in 2012, according to her career summary on the StackAdapt blog.
facts.quote: eventually earned my public accounting license in 2012.

facts.fact: Kim Stedman spent six years in the real estate industry before moving to the cannabis industry.
facts.quote: I continued in real estate for six years, but eventually took a new opportunity in a different industry, cannabis.
